introduction: Compare the published Building 1–5 layouts and floorplates, with their source-specific printed area figures.
selectorLabel: Choose a building, full residence spread or original location drawing
note: All 73 complete source sheets retain their original artwork and notices. Building 1 labels its values total area. Buildings 2–5 distinguish total net from separately printed gross area. Paired totals describe separate homes. Garden and balcony areas remain within the source scope. Building 1 repeats B.5 mirror sheets 20/21 and prints level G on sheet 31. Its B.1 mirror and standard totals differ. Building 2 sheet 6 incorrectly heads two-bedroom C2.C/C2.D drawings as one bedroom. The Building 3 pack floorplate is headed Olfah 2 and remains disputed. Current building markers and earlier pack maps retain their separate revisions. Confirm the contracted building, level, unit, final area and drawing revision.
